reasons.persona_fit: Accurately addresses the small business owner-operator in a calm, practical tone without hype, keeping human ownership central and adhering strictly to the no-CTA brief.
reasons.clarity: The core premise is stated immediately, followed by a transparent, step-by-step diagnostic process in concise, accessible English.
reasons.actionability: Provides a highly concrete, bounded audit step (checking the last five proposals or customer conversations against website copy) before any automation is attempted.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no fabricated customer, capability, or performance claims, remaining completely within the approved evidence and scope boundaries.
